notes.how_to_fill: Replace launch/args/shot_dir with your own absolute paths. Keep title_pattern specific to avoid killing an editor window.
notes.single_instance_rule: Only one game window at a time; close leftovers before launch; never launch while a human is testing.
notes.debug_keys_developer_only: F-keys/debug HUD belong to the white-box developer agent; black-box testers must not use them (no cheating).
